title: Restore One File
description: config.ini has accidental local edits. Other workspace files must be left alone.
mission: Restore only config.ini to the version recorded in HEAD.
success: config.ini matches the committed production configuration again.

lesson.what_happened: Only the working-tree copy changed; HEAD still contained the correct configuration.
lesson.be_careful: Restoring discards uncommitted edits to the selected path.

hints: Use git status and git diff to inspect the local change.
Git can restore one path without resetting the whole repository.

ja.title: 特定fileだけ復元
ja.description: config.iniだけに誤ったlocal変更があります。
ja.mission: config.iniだけをHEADに記録された内容へ戻してください。
hints: git statusとgit diffで変更を確認します。
repository全体をresetせず一つのpathだけ復元できます。
git restore config.iniを調べてください。

lesson.what_happened: working treeだけが変わりHEADには正しい設定が残っていました。
lesson.be_careful: restoreは選択pathの未commit変更を破棄します。
